LOW.label: Low Risk
LOW.description: Favorable risk profile with minimal operational or market vulnerabilities.

MEDIUM.label: Moderate Risk
MEDIUM.description: Standard business risks present that can be managed with basic operational buffers.

HIGH.label: High Risk
HIGH.description: Significant category or market risks identified requiring active risk mitigation.

CRITICAL.label: Critical Risk
CRITICAL.description: Multiple compounded high-severity risks requiring fundamental restructuring before launch.

competitionRiskThresholds.highReason: Local area exhibits high competitor concentration, increasing pricing pressure and customer acquisition challenges.
competitionRiskThresholds.moderateReason: Moderate competitor presence in analysis radius requiring clear service differentiation.
competitionRiskThresholds.highMitigation: Differentiate through specialized merchandise, extended operating hours, loyalty perks, home delivery, or digital payments.
competitionRiskThresholds.moderateMitigation: Focus on high-quality customer service, reliable inventory availability, and competitive pricing.
